plain_english_policy: This bill extends the life of an existing state commission by one year. The policy direction is to allow the Lieutenant Governor's Commission on Public-Private Partnership Projects to continue its work, specifically implementing recommendations from a previous report and conducting informational briefings with experts in public-private partnerships (P-3). This enables further study of how such projects could be applied within Alabama.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would extend the commission's existence until the fifth legislative day of the 2011 Regular Session, allowing it to continue implementing recommendations from its original report and conducting briefings with P-3 experts for interested parties, including legislators. It does not create new projects or authorize spending beyond what is already established.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support extending the commission's life to continue its study and implementation of public-private partnership recommendations. They do not infer positions beyond this extension.
evidence_quotes: "That the Lieutenant Governor's Commission on Public-Private Partnership Projects continue with implementation of the recommendations included in its original report to the Legislature"
"and that the commission be extended until the fifth legislative day of the 2011 Regular Session of the Alabama Legislature."
